contract.ranking: Original complete closed approval day, score DESC/ID ASC, floor(N/10), unknown outcomes compete before all outcome/group masks.
contract.phase_scope: All12 original phases at all5 seeds, original outcome cutoff per fold. No repeated historical month pooling and no original retained-holdout scoring.
contract.event_cohort: Exactly legacy add_delay_target eligibility: final delivered status, valid purchase<=approval<=delivery, valid promise day>=approval day. This audited legacy cohort is not status-free raw delivery history.
contract.feature_clock: Actual customer-delivery event in [approval-90d,approval), or [approval-30d,approval); lower inclusive, upper exclusive. No deadline training clock. Same-ID query/event approvals must match, so own delivery cannot enter own history.
contract.assumptions: Event time proxies knowledge time; no ingestion/revision clocks. Original promise and static primary seller/customer states use final exported attributes under prior approval-time availability assumptions.
contract.query_scope: Exactly frozen70844-row138-column pre-May feature cohort; original columns and values remain unchanged. New audit fields never enter model feature lists.
contract.primary_seller: Highest item price then smallest item sequence, same original lookup; state route is seller state -> customer state, not a carrier route.

candidates.seller_promise_cdf_90d: Same seller completed calendar-day durations <= current query promise; (seller count_le +20*current global CDF)/(seller n+20). Unknown seller or empty global gives null; known empty seller history uses global prior.
candidates.seller_route_delay_rate_90d: Joint primary seller x state-route completed delayed count, with20 pseudo outcomes at current existing route90 rate. Unknown key gives null; zero local n equals route prior.
candidates.route_recent30_delay_rate_excess90d: Route30 completed delayed rate shrunk with20 current global30 pseudo outcomes (global30 shrunk with20 at0.05), minus existing route90 rate. 30d is nested in90d, not independent; zero route30 n can still yield nonzero excess from priors.

contract.cohorts: Known/on-time/delayed; same-identity all20 common FN vs other delayed; each of all five seed own four-model common FN in fixed focus groups. Outcome labels only define retrospective diagnosis cohorts.
contract.statistics: Missing/finite counts and min/p10/p50/p90/max/mean; zero denominator rates null. Support and priors remain separate. Original-label-free Spearman/duplicate checks describe association, not new-feature benefit or causality.
contract.training_decision: Audit first; do not auto-select a candidate using these inspected outcomes. New single-factor training needs a separately frozen specification; baseline101x0.8, five seeds, original preprocessing/clocks and full-day10% remain the reference.
contract.privacy: Public only aggregates, source names and hashes; per-query cache stays Git ignored; no IDs, seller identities, individual scores or labels exported publicly.
prohibitions: No model deserialization/replay/fit or new alerts, budgets, subgroup quotas, seed choice, ensemble, or default-model change.
No query feature or scoring at/after2018-05-01. No current or future query outcome used to construct history.
Do not claim completed history covers pending/slow unfinished/cancelled orders; do not identify a cause from common-miss conditional profiles.
